notes.title: Release of the game!
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

We are beyond excited to let you know that our horror indie game is finally releasing!

It's been quite a rollercoaster ride during the development, but we've managed to bring this game to life. We owe a massive shoutout to each and every one of you who have been with us on this journey and to those who tried our demo and shared their valuable feedback!

We hope you will enjoy our game!

Elite Lords Studios
